setting_notes: The ontology models rural village life and farm labor shaped by family legacy, love, survival, and duty. Most verbs and nouns reference medieval rural activities and roles, supporting inheritance, farming, subsistence, and social negotiation. Primitive anchors tie to physical resources, tools, and basic interactions.

verbs.gloss: carry an item from one place to another
examine entity or location for detail
supply water to crops or land
help another actor with their task
be present at an event or place
act in accord with a norm or rule
ready an object or self for use
take active part in group effort

nouns.gloss: any item that can be eaten
area for agriculture and animal husbandry
kinship group by blood or marriage
